# Loading the relevant R packages

```{r}
# Loading the relevant R packages:
library(pacman)
p_load(randomForest, ggplot2, pheatmap, pROC, ggsci, caret)
source("scripts/stat_plot_functions.R")
```

# Location_bac
```{r}
Group="Location"
# Read the experimental design and taxonomic classification files
design = read.table("metadata_bac.tsv",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
otu_table =read.table("sum_g_bac.txt",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")

target_col <- paste0("rf", Group)
design_sub = design[design[[target_col]] == "Train", ]
summary(design_sub)

# Filter OTUs
idx = rownames(design_sub) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_sub = design_sub[idx,]
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_table[, rownames(design_sub)]))  
design_sub[[Group]] <- factor(design_sub[[Group]])


# Random forest classification
set.seed(325)
rf = randomForest(otutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], importance=TRUE, proximity=TRUE, ntree = 1000)
print(rf)
capture.output(print(rf), file = paste0("rf_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))


# Export feature importance
# Preview and save feature contributions based on the validation results
imp= as.data.frame(round(rf$importance,2))
imp = imp[order(imp$MeanDecreaseAccuracy,decreasing = F),]
write.table(imp, file = "tax_imp_bac.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)
# Add family annotation
system("awk 'NR==FNR{a[$7]=$5} NR>FNR{print $0\"\t\"a[$1]}' taxonomy_bac.txt tax_imp_bac.txt | sed '1 s/$/Order/' > tax_imp_order_bac.txt")



# Feature selection through cross-validation
n = ncol(otutab_t)-1
myotutab_t= otutab_t[1:n]
set.seed(325)
result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
# result$n.var
# length(result$n.var)
with(result, plot(n.var, error.cv, log="x", type="o", lwd=2))
result1 = result

error.cv = data.frame(num = result$n.var, error.1 =  result$error.cv)
for (i in 316:(315+4)){
  print(i)
  set.seed(i)
  result= rfcv(myotutab_t, design_sub[[Group]], cv.fold=5, scale = "log", step = 0.9)
  error.cv = cbind(error.cv, result$error.cv)
}

# a1. Cross validation for feature selection
# ggplot2 visualize result of cross validation
n.var = error.cv$num
error.cv = error.cv[,2:6]
colnames(error.cv) = paste('err',1:5,sep='.')
err.mean = apply(error.cv,1,mean)
allerr = data.frame(num=n.var,err.mean=err.mean,error.cv)

# number of features selected
# Select the num corresponding to the minimum err.mean in allerr
optimal = 61

write.table(allerr, file =paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_bac.txt", sep=""), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T)

p = ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.1), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.2), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.3), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.4), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.5), colour = 'grey') + 
  geom_line(aes(x = allerr$num, y = allerr$err.mean), colour = 'black') + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = optimal, colour='black', lwd=0.36, linetype="dashed") + 
  coord_trans(x = "log2") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100, 150, 200)) +
  labs(title=paste('Training set (n = ', dim(otutab_t)[1],')', sep = ''), 
       x='Number of genus ', y='Cross-validation error rate') + 
  annotate("text", x = optimal, y = max(allerr$err.mean), label=paste("optimal = ", optimal, sep="")) + 
  coord_flip() +
  main_theme 
ggsave(p, file = paste0("tax_rfcv_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), width = 80, height = 89, unit = 'mm')
p

# a2. Features barplot with taxonomy in Family ggplot2 visualization and styling of feature contributions
imp = read.table("tax_imp_order_bac.txt", header=T, row.names= 1, sep="\t") 
imp = tail(imp, n = 10)
imp$Genus = factor(rownames(imp), levels = rownames(imp))

p = ggplot(imp, aes(x = Genus, y = MeanDecreaseAccuracy, fill = Order)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + 
  coord_flip() + main_theme
ggsave(paste0("tax_top_feautre_bac_",Group,".pdf", sep=""), p, width=89 * 1.5, height=50 * 1.5, unit='mm')
p

# ROC
# --- Generate publication-quality ROC curves using ggplot2 ---
# 1. Calculate ROC objects for all Location classes and store them in a list
prob_mat <- rf$votes
actual_label <- design_sub[[Group]]
classes <- levels(actual_label)

roc_list <- list()
for (class_name in classes) {
  roc_list[[class_name]] <- roc(actual_label == class_name, 
                                prob_mat[, class_name], 
                                quiet = TRUE)
}

# 2. Convert to a ggplot object using ggroc
# Pass the list to ggroc to automatically generate legend labels based on the list names
p <- ggroc(roc_list, legacy.axes = TRUE, size = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") + 
  
  # 3. Enhance the color scheme using the NPG (Nature Publishing Group) color palette
  scale_color_npg(name = Group, 
                  labels = paste(names(roc_list), " (AUC = ", 
                                 sapply(roc_list, function(x) sprintf("%.3f", auc(x))), ")", sep="")) +
  
  # 4. Set axes and labels
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
       y = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)",
       title = "ROC Curves for Random Forest Classification") +
  
  # 5. Customize the publication-quality theme
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = c(0.75, 0.25),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.5)),
    aspect.ratio = 1 
  )


# 6. Export
ggsave(paste0("ROC_Curves_FRI_Submission_",Group,"_bac.pdf", sep=""), p, width = 6, height = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 600)



# Independent validation
design_test = design[design[[target_col]] == "Test", ]
summary(design_test)
idx = rownames(design_test) %in% colnames(otu_table)
design_test = design_test[idx,]
otu_sub = otu_table[,rownames(design_test)]

# Transpose the table and add grouping information
otutab_t = as.data.frame(t(otu_sub))
otutab_t[[Group]] = design[rownames(otutab_t),][[Group]]


# Perform validation using the random forest model fitted to the training set
set.seed(325)
otutab.pred = predict(rf, t(otu_sub) )  
pre_tab = table(observed=otutab_t[,Group],
                predicted=otutab.pred) 
pre_tab

capture.output(print(pre_tab), file = paste0("pre_tab_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

test_real_Group <- as.factor(design_test[[Group]]) 

evaluation <- confusionMatrix(otutab.pred, test_real_Group)

# 4. Print the complete evaluation results
capture.output(print(evaluation), file = paste0("evaluation_", Group, "_summary_bac.txt"))

# Visualize the validation results
# Organize the original sample groups and predicted classifications
predict = data.frame(group = otutab_t[,Group], predicted=otutab.pred)

# Save the prediction results table
write.table("SampleID\t", file=paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt",sep=""),append = F, quote = F, eol = "", row.names = F, col.names = F)
write.table(predict, file = paste0("RF_prediction_binary_tax_", Group, "_bac.txt"),append = T, quote = F, row.names = T, col.names = T, sep = "\t")
```

# Location_fun

```{r}
Group="Location"
design = read.table("metadata_fun.tsv",header = T, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")

set.seed(325)
```
